children: Emirates will deploy its Airbus A350 on flights between Dubai and Nairobi from October 25, 2026, bringing its latest-generation aircraft and cabin experience to Kenya.
The A350 will operate flights EK717 and EK718, marking the first time Emirates’ Premium Economy cabin will be offered on flights to and from Nairobi.
The aircraft accommodates 298 passengers across Business, Premium Economy and Economy cabins.

“ The arrival of the A350 in Nairobi marks an exciting new chapter for Emirates in Kenya. We’re delighted to bring our latest aircraft and onboard experience to our customers in market, with more comfort, choice and thoughtful touches in every cabin,” said Christophe Leloup, Emirates Country Manager in Kenya.

The Premium Economy cabin features reclining leather seats, additional legroom, 13.3-inch screens and charging points. Business Class offers a 1-2-1 layout with lie-flat seats and direct aisle access, while Economy includes upgraded entertainment and redesigned interiors.
The deployment follows Emirates’ expansion to 21 weekly Nairobi flights, including a third daily service introduced in July.

title: ZAWYA: Emirates introduces A350, Premium Economy to Nairobi route
